description: OpenAPI Security Audit — Static security review of an OpenAPI 3.x or Swagger 2.0 spec mapped to the OWASP API Security Top 10 (2023): missing or undefined auth schemes, unauthenticated or optional-auth write operations and sensitive paths (admin, users, tokens, billing, export...), API keys or secrets in query strings, Basic auth, OAuth implicit/password flows, plain-HTTP servers and OAuth URLs, non-production servers, debug endpoints, TRACE, unbounded page sizes and arrays, sensitive fields in responses, mass-assignable privileged fields, missing 401/403 and 429 docs. spec= JSON or YAML text, or url= (GitHub blob links converted to raw). Returns PASS/REVIEW/FIX BEFORE RELEASE/BLOCK, score, grade and findings. Price: $0.006 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: security_openapi_check
